title: Horizontal distance s
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the horizontal distance s from the platform to point A using projectile motion kinematics.

title: Velocity magnitude at A
description: Essential: Correctly determines the speed at point A by combining horizontal and vertical velocity components.

title: Central angle theta
description: Important: Correctly relates the landing angle to the geometry of the circular track to find the central angle.

title: Normal force at A
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law and centripetal force at point A to find the normal force.

title: Normal force at O
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law and centripetal force at the lowest point O to find the normal force.

title: Projectile time calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time of flight from the platform to the ground using vertical displacement.

title: Velocity direction at A
description: Optional: Correctly determines the angle of the velocity vector relative to the horizontal at point A.

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign (e.g., mg + N = mv^2/R) in the centripetal force equation at points A or O.

title: Unit or value oversight
description: Pitfall: Omits units in final answers, uses incorrect g, or misapplies the given trigonometric values.
